summary: Make docker-compose.yml governance and operator-bff PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_JWT_SECRET fail closed (empty when unset), document explicit secret in .env.example, fix test_stage_promotion_compose.py expectations to match canonical fail-closed compose and consolidated deploy helper, and verify rendered compose for dev profiles.

acceptance_criteria.ac1_fail_closed: No service in docker-compose.yml verifies or signs JWTs with a published default secret; PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_JWT_SECRET for governance and operator-bff resolves only from explicit environment and is empty (fail closed) when unset.
acceptance_criteria.ac2_env_example: Local full-stack reproduction that needs the secret gets it from explicit environment documented in .env.example; nothing in the repository supplies a usable default JWT secret.
acceptance_criteria.ac3_test_passed: services/runtime-manager/test_stage_promotion_compose.py passes; the deploy canary test checks that every rollout path in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh goes through with_dev_bff_runtime_env and that the helper sets PANTHEON_CANARY_EXECUTION_ENABLED=false instead of counting literal occurrences.
acceptance_criteria.ac4_deciding_commits_classified: Each changed test expectation is classified in the evidence with its deciding commit (442327f5b added the published default and a4dcf76ce consolidated the deploy environment into the shared helper).
acceptance_criteria.ac5_rendered_compose_dev_profiles: Rendered compose for the dev profiles still starts governance and operator-bff with the secret the deploy script passes (PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET) and the evidence shows the rendered values with the secret redacted.

test_dev_compose_wires_shared_jwt_verifi.decision: Commit 442327f5b introduced a fallback to a published default secret (pantheon-local-governance-jwt-secret) in docker-compose.yml for governance and operator-bff. The secret is now made fail-closed (${PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_JWT_SECRET:-${PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET:-}}). The test expectation was updated from the stale 3b9336b0d assertion (${PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_SECRET:-}) to assert the canonical fail-closed expression without published defaults for both governance and operator-bff.

test_dev_deploy_script_explicitly_keeps_.decision: Commit a4dcf76ce consolidated the dev deployment runtime environment into the shared with_dev_bff_runtime_env helper, eliminating duplicate inline environment exports and leaving exactly 1 occurrence of PANTHEON_CANARY_EXECUTION_ENABLED=false in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh. The test was updated to verify that with_dev_bff_runtime_env explicitly sets PANTHEON_CANARY_EXECUTION_ENABLED=false and that each dev rollout path (root and bff) executes through with_dev_bff_runtime_env.
